title: Actuals coverage gate policy
description: What share of a production period must be covered by accepted actuals evidence before the period may be submitted for approval, and which substitutes count. Spec ACT05 (coverageRatio, measured vs estimated quantity; approval needs 100 % accepted coverage, approved substitutions count, estimated share exposed, unless a versioned policy says otherwise), ACT02 (spanning output events need measured distribution or an approved proportional estimate marked Estimated). Decision D05. Consumed by sub-phase 2.4 (ActualsRunner) and 2.8 (submit gate).

requiredCoverageRatio.description: Minimum `actuals_results.coverage_ratio` (accepted seconds / period seconds) for every slice before `submit` succeeds (ACT05). 1 = 100 %.

allowProportionalEstimate.description: Permit a time-proportional split of an output event that spans a period boundary when the event carries no measured distribution; the split quantity is marked `estimated` and exposed as `estimatedQuantity` (ACT02, ACT05). False leaves the slice `partial`.

countApprovedSubstitutionsAsAccepted.description: Approved manual adjustments and approved fallback-source segments count toward coverage (ACT05 'approved substitutions count'); their share is still reported separately.
